pieces.Text: As a standard action, a character wielding a stalking weapon can command it to study a creature within 60 feet. When the wielder attacks the studied creature, on a successful hit the stalking weapon deals +1d6 points of bonus damage per consecutive round spent studying a target, up to a number of bonus dice equal to the stalking weapon's enhancement bonus.
